text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 24, 2024) for 45 Gulliver Road.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 24, 2024) for 45 Gulliver Road, Folder Number 24 215170 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
